Door Installation Atlanta

You're looking for a reliable contractor to install doors in your Atlanta home. Build Heritage offers door installation as part of its services, and you can get a free, written, and itemized quote for door installation services.

About Build Heritage

Build Heritage is a Georgia home-services contractor serving metro Atlanta and Georgia, with a team that is licensed and insured in Georgia. We serve areas including Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, Roswell, Sandy Springs, Johns Creek, Duluth, Lawrenceville, Decatur, Smyrna, Kennesaw, Woodstock, Cumming, Gainesville, Athens, Augusta, Macon, Savannah, and Columbus.

What You Get and What It Costs

Our door installation services are part of the 8 trades we offer, which also include Painting, Drywall, Flooring & Vinyl, Framing, Window & Door Trim, Roofing & Tiles, and Packing & Moving. You can expect to pay a price within the ranges outlined in our 2026 cost guide, which was updated in August 2026. For example, our cost guide provides ranges for other services, such as full roof replacement ($9,000-$20,000) and whole-home interior repaint ($3,000-$8,000). We recommend holding back 10-15% on top of your quote to account for any hidden issues that may arise during the installation process.

FAQ

What areas do you serve? We serve the entire metro Atlanta area, including cities like Atlanta, Marietta, Alpharetta, and Roswell. How do I get a quote? You can contact us through the quote form or email us at info@buildheritage.org. How long does it take to get a response? We respond to all quote requests within one business day.
